baseline: Non-selectable comparator: every full-hour 15m bar close in confirmed 4H direction; same 208-bar warmup and fills. Report in addition to 12 candidates and 12 matched controls.

previous_day_failed_break.trigger: prior complete calendar day extreme sweep/reclaim, CLV70%, opposite-day progress>=0.2ADR and open not recovered

opening_range_retest.trigger: 00:00-04:00 complete opening range, close breakout then retest 1-4 bars later

period_semantics: inclusive start, exclusive end; each period starts flat; last bar forced close included in net win rate
prior_exposure: All periods may have been seen in earlier research. Frozen 12 intraday candidates unchanged; historical data may have vendor revisions.

execution.entry: next observed open only when gap <= 15 minutes
execution.stop: signal close +/- 2 ATR; short stop includes spread
execution.target: one initial risk from actual entry including entry slippage
execution.intrabar: opening gap first, then adverse stop-first for dual touch
execution.commission: metadata commission per lot each side; reject nonzero until currency interpretation verified
execution.max_positions: one per symbol; up to 5 aggregate
execution.risk: fixed 0.25% of reference starting capital per trade, normalized R; realized-only DD

selection: Diagnostic rerun only: all frozen candidates and controls across all periods. No selection, no retuning, no live approval. Later periods are descriptive, not untouched holdout. Report all-period gates, but passing needs a separate validation decision.
stress: Not a selection experiment; no stress test and no adoption permitted.
data_quality: monotonic unique aligned bars, finite OHLC consistency, every period edge within 7 days; report >7day interior gaps; abort on those gaps
hypothesis: Condition entries on causally observed intraday direction, prior-day levels, opening-range sequence and consumed historical daily range; test benefit against matched state-gate ablations.
day_definition: Source-naive calendar date 00:00; broker timezone/DST unverified. Never label these as JST/UTC/New York trading days. Current day needs a 00:00 bar and consecutive 15m bars through signal. Prior-day levels require previous calendar date with all 96 bars. ADR20 uses 20 completed 96-bar days, excludes today. Initial range uses completed 00:00-04:00 only. Signal times 02:00<=bar time<20:00; opening-range entries after 04:00.
comparison: One non-selectable matched ablation per candidate removes only intraday direction/progress/consumed-range gates. Structural entry triggers, previous-day levels, opening range sequence, time and data-quality gates remain unchanged. Duplicate ablation behavior across parameter variants is allowed and disclosed.
frozen_at: Before performance evaluation of refreshed history in this run
universe: Five non-USD JPY crosses with complete refreshed history; NZDJPY now available. CADJPY absent.
gate_adjustment: ceil(8/11 * 5) = 4 positive pairs; all other absolute and context gates unchanged.
operator: Single primary agent, no subagents; separate-formula reconciliation is not independent-person review.
